✓ Suez Canal.fact: The canal extends from the northern terminus of Port Said to the southern terminus of Port Tewfik at the city of Suez. It contained, according to Alois Negrelli's plans, no locks, with seawater flowing freely through it.  In general, the water in the canal north of the Bitter Lakes flows north in winter and south in summer.  South of the lakes, the current changes with the tide at Suez.
